axia corporation limited: Retail and distribution conglomerate selling furniture, appliances and electronics across Zimbabwe, through brands including TV Sales & Home and Distribution Group Africa.
caledonia mining corporation plc: Gold mining company; operates the Blanket Mine in Zimbabwe, one of the country's largest gold producers.
econet infraco: Builds and leases telecommunications towers and infrastructure; part of the Econet group of companies.
edgars stores limited: Clothing and footwear retail chain with stores across Zimbabwe.
first capital bank limited: Commercial bank offering retail, corporate and investment banking services in Zimbabwe.
innscor africa limited: Diversified food and FMCG group — bakeries (Bakers Inn), meat processing (Colcom), packaging and other consumer brands; also the parent company of Simbisa Brands.
invictus energy limited depository recei: Oil and gas exploration company focused on the Cabora Bassa Basin in northern Zimbabwe.
kavango resources plc: Mineral exploration company searching for copper, nickel and gold deposits in Botswana.
nedbank group limited depository receipt: South African banking group; these are depository receipts giving VFEX investors exposure to Nedbank shares.
old mutual limited: Pan-African financial services group offering insurance, savings, investment, banking and lending; VFEX-listed via a secondary listing alongside its primary JSE listing.
padenga holdings ltd: Nile crocodile farming operation producing skins and meat for export, with a separate gold mining division.
seed co international: Certified seed producer supplying maize and other crop seed to markets across Africa, outside Zimbabwe itself.
simbisa brands limited: Fast food restaurant operator running chains including Chicken Inn, Pizza Inn, Creamy Inn and Bakers Inn.
tsl limited: Agricultural services group operating tobacco auction floors and agri-logistics in Zimbabwe.
west prop holdings limited: Real estate developer, known for large residential/commercial developments including Pomona City in Harare.
zimplow holdings limited: Manufactures and distributes agricultural implements and equipment for Zimbabwean farmers.
afdis distillers limited: Producer of spirits and wines, one of Zimbabwe's main alcoholic beverage manufacturers.
amalgamated regional trading (art) holdi: Motor vehicle and equipment dealership group operating across Zimbabwe.
ariston holdings limited: Agricultural producer growing tea, coffee, macadamia nuts and horticultural crops.
british american tobacco zimbabwe limite: Manufactures and markets tobacco products; the Zimbabwean arm of British American Tobacco.
cafca limited: Manufactures power cables and related electrical products for the Zimbabwean and regional market.
cbz holdings limited: Zimbabwe's largest banking and financial services group, spanning banking, insurance, asset management and wealth management.
cfi holdings limited: Agricultural inputs and retail group, operating the Farm & City chain of stores.
dairibord holdings limited: Dairy and beverage producer — milk, yoghurt, juices and related consumer products.
delta corporation limited: Zimbabwe's largest beverages producer, making beer and soft drinks (including local Coca-Cola bottling).
fbc holdings limited: Diversified financial services group spanning banking, insurance and a building society.
general beltings holdings limited: Manufactures conveyor belting and industrial rubber products, based in Bulawayo.
hippo valley estates limited: Grows and mills sugar cane; one of Zimbabwe's two major sugar producers.
mashonaland holdings limited: Property investment and management company owning commercial and industrial real estate.
meikles limited: Hospitality and retail conglomerate, historically linked to Meikles Hotel and major Zimbabwean supermarket chains.
nampak zimbabwe limited: Manufactures paper, plastic and metal packaging products.
nmbz holdings limited: Banking group; parent company of NMB Bank.
proplastics limited: Manufactures PVC pipes and plastic products for construction and plumbing.
rainbow tourism group limited: Hotel and hospitality operator running a chain of hotels across Zimbabwe.
riozim limited: Mining company producing gold and other minerals.
seed co limited: Certified seed producer supplying the domestic Zimbabwean agricultural market.
starafricacorporation limited: Sugar refining company producing granulated sugar and specialty sugar products under the Goldstar brand.
tanganda tea company limited: Grows and processes tea; one of Zimbabwe's major tea producers.
tn cybertech investments holdings limite: Digital and banking technology group, formerly EcoCash Holdings; now the parent of TN CyberTech Bank, focused on digital-first banking.
turnall holdings limited: Manufactures fibre-cement roofing sheets, pipes and building materials.
willdale limited: Manufactures clay bricks and related building products.
zb financial holdings limited: Banking, insurance and asset management group.
zeco holdings limited: Manufactures rail wagons and locomotives for regional utilities, plus steel products like roller shutters and garage doors.
zimbabwe newspapers (1980) limited: Publisher of The Herald and other major national newspapers in Zimbabwe.
zimbabwe stock exchange holdings limited: Operates the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange itself — the main board this list of companies is drawn from.
